name: WELLNEO SUGAR Co., Ltd.
summary: WELLNEO SUGAR Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells sugar and other food products primarily in Japan. It operates in Sugar Business and Food & Wellness segments. The Sugar business segment offers sugar under the Cup, Kururu, and SEVEN brand names. The Food & Wellness segment provides functional food materials, food additives, edible films, pharmaceutical and cosmetic materials, and sugar-derived sweetener products, as well as operates gym. It also operates a refrigerated warehouse and warehousing business for storage, cargo handling, and harbor transportation services. The company was formerly known as Nissin Sugar Co., Ltd.
